Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the June 06, 2022, meeting.

  2. Inland Cutter Service Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  providing services for emergency repair and parts for the cutter machine.

  3. Aftermath – Executive session to discuss to recommend payment for biohazard clean up
  services for the Police Department.

  4. Bayside Medical Center – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for services
  provided to the Police Department for background checks.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.
